rem Luxury Hampers
rem https://projecteuler.net/problem=236
rem Two suppliers send five products
rem each, A and B, in the amounts below.
rem The spoiled share of each product is
rem m times higher for B than for A, yet
rem the total share is m times higher
rem for A. Find the largest m as u/v.

use numbers
use sequences
use text
use io
use cli

arg Top integer = 5248

rem With a spoiled of A and b of B for a
rem product, b / B = m a / A, so product
rem 1 gives m = 41 b / (5 a) for a up to
rem Top and b up to 640: these are the m
rem to test. For m = u / v the products
rem fall in three groups of equal B / A:
rem 5/41, 59/41 and 59/90, so the
rem spoiled a = d t and b = n t for each
rem product, with n/d the ratio of its
rem group times m, and t from 1 up to a
rem bound. Sums of t in a group may take
rem every value between the number of
rem products and the sum of the bounds,
rem and the total share gives one
rem equation c0 s0 + c1 s1 + c2 s2 = 0,
rem tried with s0 and solved for s1, s2
rem by the extended Euclid algorithm.
Ap = array 5248 1312 2624 5760 3936
Bp = array 640 1888 3776 3776 5664
Gi = array 0 1 1 2 1
Gb = array 5 59 59
Ga = array 41 41 90
Sa = 18880
Sb = 15744
Gn = array shape 3 fill 0
Gd = array shape 3 fill 0
Lo = array shape 3 fill 0
Hi = array shape 3 fill 0
Cc = array shape 3 fill 0
fun Bs St Lw Hg trng
  Tl = 0
  Th = 0
  if St greater 0
    Tl = 0 - ((Bs - Lw) // St)
    Th = (Hg - Bs) // St
  else
    Tl = 0 - ((Bs - Hg) // St)
    Th = (Lw - Bs) // St
  end
  return array Tl Th
end
Bu = 1
Bv = 1
Cnt = 0
for A in 1 to Top
  for B in 1 to 640
    U = 41 * B
    V = 5 * A
    if U at most V
      continue
    end
    G1 = U
    G2 = V
    for
      if G2 equal 0
        break
      end
      Tt = G1 mod G2
      G1 = G2
      G2 = Tt
    end
    U = U // G1
    V = V // G1
    G5 = 5 gcd V
    G41 = 41 gcd U
    Km = (5 // G5) * (41 // G41)
    if V * Km // 5 not equal A
      continue
    end
    Ok = 1
    for G in 0 to 2
      N = U * Gb G
      D = V * Ga G
      G1 = N
      G2 = D
      for
        if G2 equal 0
          break
        end
        Tt = G1 mod G2
        G1 = G2
        G2 = Tt
      end
      Gn G = N // G1
      Gd G = D // G1
      Lo G = 0
      Hi G = 0
      Cd = V * Sb * D
      Cn = U * Sa * N
      Cc G = (Cd - Cn) // G1
    end
    for I in 0 to 4
      G = Gi I
      Ub = Ap I // (Gd G)
      Ub2 = Bp I // (Gn G)
      if Ub2 less Ub
        Ub = Ub2
      end
      if Ub less 1
        Ok = 0
      end
      Lo G += 1
      Hi G += Ub
    end
    if Ok equal 0
      continue
    end
    C0 = Cc 0
    C1 = Cc 1
    C2 = Cc 2
    A1 = C1 abs
    A2 = C2 abs
    R0 = A1
    R1 = A2
    S0 = 1
    S1 = 0
    T0 = 0
    T1 = 1
    for
      if R1 equal 0
        break
      end
      Qt = R0 // R1
      Nr = R0 - Qt * R1
      R0 = R1
      R1 = Nr
      Ns = S0 - Qt * S1
      S0 = S1
      S1 = Ns
      Nt = T0 - Qt * T1
      T0 = T1
      T1 = Nt
    end
    Gg = R0
    X0 = S0
    Y0 = T0
    if C1 less 0
      X0 = 0 - X0
    end
    if C2 less 0
      Y0 = 0 - Y0
    end
    Found = 0
    for S in (Lo 0) to (Hi 0)
      Rhs = 0 - C0 * S
      if C1 equal 0 and C2 equal 0
        if Rhs equal 0
          Found = 1
        end
      end
      if C1 equal 0 and C2 not equal 0
        Q1 = Rhs // C2
        L2 = Lo 2
        Dv2 = Rhs mod C2 equal 0
        if Dv2 and Q1 at least L2
          if Q1 at most (Hi 2)
            Found = 1
          end
        end
      end
      if C2 equal 0 and C1 not equal 0
        Q1 = Rhs // C1
        L1 = Lo 1
        Dv1 = Rhs mod C1 equal 0
        if Dv1 and Q1 at least L1
          if Q1 at most (Hi 1)
            Found = 1
          end
        end
      end
      Z1 = C1 not equal 0
      Z2 = C2 not equal 0
      Nz = Z1 and Z2
      if Nz
        if Rhs mod Gg equal 0
          Kq = Rhs // Gg
          St1 = C2 // Gg
          St2 = 0 - C1 // Gg
          Lw1 = Lo 1
          Hg1 = Hi 1
          Lw2 = Lo 2
          Hg2 = Hi 2
          Bs1 = X0 * Kq
          Bs2 = Y0 * Kq
          Ra = Bs1 St1 Lw1 Hg1 trng
          Rb = Bs2 St2 Lw2 Hg2 trng
          Tl = Ra 0
          if Rb 0 greater Tl
            Tl = Rb 0
          end
          Th = Ra 1
          if Rb 1 less Th
            Th = Rb 1
          end
          if Tl at most Th
            Found = 1
          end
        end
      end
      if Found equal 1
        break
      end
    end
    if Found equal 1
      Cnt += 1
      if U * Bv greater Bu * V
        Bu = U
        Bv = V
      end
    end
  end
end
Pair = array Bu Bv
Answer = Pair join "/"
Answer print
